sourceReceipts.finding: The current government procedure describes a seven-digit identifier associated with a property and requires commune, street and municipal number. It is a single address-dependent lookup path, not a complete assignment release or postal-area dataset.

The fixed two-page procedure repeats the commune, street and number lookup and says the result is the postcode of a specified property. It provides no finite denominator, aliases, validity history, bulk download, geometry, CRS or reuse grant.

The public interface requires commune, street and number. No address was submitted, no CAPTCHA was bypassed and no response row was acquired. Its HTML is not a current complete assignment or polygon artifact.

The sheet defines a three-digit distribution area and four-digit sequential block-face identifier. It separately documents post-office codes for P.O. boxes, commune fallbacks and rural no-number addresses. It contains no Polygon/MultiPolygon, CRS or topology schema and is not a current assignment release.
The official catalog exposes public CSW GetRecords with CQL_TEXT and a maximum of 100 records per request. Catalog metadata was queried without downloading feature or address rows.
The exact official catalog phrase query matched and returned zero records. This is time-bound catalog evidence, not proof that no unpublished or restricted data exists.
The broad catalog query matched only Controles Fronterizos 2018 and 2019 because their abstracts mention international postal shipments. Neither record is a postcode assignment or area layer.

The official developer documentation describes customer user/password or token access. No authentication was attempted.
Integration requires customer and company identifiers and contact details. The form was not submitted and no agreement was accepted.

blocker.summary: No current complete reusable CorreosChile seven-digit assignment release, compatible public-serving rights or real full-code Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact was established.
reasons: The public lookup is address-input and observation-based, not a complete versioned finite assignment release.
The credentialed normalization API returns address and postcode fields without geometry and requires customer access that was not requested or used.
Full codes normally identify a block face, while commune fallback, post-office, P.O. box and rural cases are non-uniform and cannot be forced into one area class.
The official Geoportal catalog returned no codigo postal layer; its two broad postal matches are unrelated border-control datasets.
DPA 2023 polygons are administrative region, province and commune geometry, not postal geometry.
No written rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public area serving were established.
unblockConditions: Acquire with approval an exact current CorreosChile release containing the complete assignment denominator, aliases, validity, corrections, exceptions and typed postal objects.
Pin written terms that permit the intended AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving.

For every drawable code, publish a reproducible rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source release, reference date, CRS, topology, confidence and exceptions.
Keep block-face, commune-fallback, post-office, P.O. box and rural non-area objects typed and surface-free where a valid area does not exist.
Drive the real CL API and application through all required search, error, fit, render, clear and re-search states and record deterministic real-app evidence.
